description: Ingest one incoming message from an external channel (Beeper network, desktop mail, …) forwarded by the local comms-forward bridge. Idempotent on (channel, external_id). Stores the message and, unless auto_draft is false, generates an AI reply DRAFT (never auto-sends) — EXCEPT when a background agent of this tenant picks up new incoming items itself (run condition inbound_messages.neu / emails.unsortiert): then that agent drafts the reply for approval and no draft is made here. Returns { ingested, message_id, draft_id, auto_draft: 'created'|'skipped_agent_handles'|'disabled'|'empty'|'failed'|'skipped_duplicate', handled_by_agent? }.

agent_id.description: Drafting agent; defaults to the tenant's first enabled agent

chat_name.description: Display name of the chat or conversation

metadata.description: Additional source data stored with the message (free-form object)

sender.description: Sender handle or ID at the source channel

name: ingest_message
